case.component: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING
case.narrative: I've had four incidents of the automatic braking system engaging and braking when there was no object in front of the car that should have required it to stop.  There doesn't seem to be a common factor.  Twice in a lighted garage.  Once on a highway while making a turn during daylight, and once on a highway going straight at night. It's very dangerous.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
